memory_candidates: VecEADecomp.lean zone decomposition: Non-bracket zones (y outside [t,x]) use sinceWitnessPred/untilWitnessPred to fold the existential witness into VecEA2 endpoint predicates as Since/Until formulas. This gives n=0 VecEA2 formulas (no bracket witness needed).

3-var equality cases: When order booleans force y = t (both order(0,2) and order(2,0) false) or y = x (both order(0,1) and order(1,0) false), the existential reduces to direct NF evaluation at the fixed point. No VecEA2 needed.

reconstruct_nf_3var: General helper that rebuilds a 3-var depth-0 NF evaluation from three 1-var NF evaluations and six order iff conditions. Handles all 15 match cases (3 pred vars with 3 possible indices each, 6 order pairs, plus impossible higher indices).
